fullSource:
use default

let pairs = LIST([
    (name = "Oxygen", value = "O"),
    (name = "Helium", value = "He"),
    (name = "Nitrogen", value = "N"),
    (name = "Carbon", value = "C"),
    (name = "Hydrogen", value = "H")
])

pairs.sort((a, b) => a.name <> b.name)

for pair in pairs do
    write_line("{pair.name}: {pair.value}")
od
output:
Carbon: C
Helium: He
Hydrogen: H
Nitrogen: N
Oxygen: O
